name: data_component_builder
description: Data Tool - Component builder to insert component instances on a page via the public-mcp headless surface. Supports inserting into an element (insert_in_element) or into a component instance's slot (insert_in_slot), with recursive nested-component trees via component_schema.slots.

siteId.description: Webflow site ID. Use list_sites to discover site IDs.

pageId.description: Any valid page id that exists in the site

build_label.description: A label to identify this build action in the results.

action_type.description: insert_in_element: insert the component as a child of parent_element_id. insert_in_slot: insert the component into a named slot of the component instance identified by parent_element_id.

component.description: The component id of the element to perform action on.

element.description: The element id of the element to perform action on.

parent_element_id.description: The id of the parent element (for insert_in_element) or the component instance (for insert_in_slot). e.g id:{component:123,element:456}.

creation_position.description: The position to insert the component. append/prepend insert as child of the parent element. before/after insert as sibling adjacent to the target element. For insert_in_slot, before/after are treated as append.

name.description: The name of the component to insert.

children.description: Child component schemas for this slot. Each child uses the same component_schema shape: { name, slots? } and may nest to any depth.

slots.description: Slots to populate with child components. Use slots[].children to build nested component trees. The child item schema is passthrough because JSON Schema cannot represent unbounded recursion reliably in MCP descriptors.

component_schema.description: The component schema to insert. Use name to specify which component. To populate slots, pass slots[] with the slot name and children[]; each child uses the same { name, slots? } shape and can nest to any depth.

slot_name.description: The slot name to insert the component into. Required when action_type is insert_in_slot.

return_component_info.description: Whether to return full component instance info for the created instance. Defaults to false.

scope_component_id.description: Optional component id. When set, the parent_element_id lookup walks this component's tree instead of the page tree — required to insert components inside a component definition.

context.description: Explain why this tool is being called and how it fits the user's goal, in 15-25 words, third person (no 'I'/'we'/'you'). Used for analytics only. Never include credentials or personal data.
